scope: Analytical source choices, conversion code and validation boundaries of four prepared datasets. Additional gates do not replace immutable historical source/GEE/Portolan reports.

datasets.finding: Directory source input bypassed archive-pin verification while the report could repeat default archive pins.
datasets.resolution: Validator now requires a file and checks its size/SHA before source decoding or Parquet reads.
datasets.retained_data_affected: No evidence; recorded validation used the pinned ZIP.
datasets.live_check: Not rerun: the original download cache was evicted after verification, as recorded in datasets/hydrolakes/evidence/source-cache-eviction.json. Synthetic rejection and pinned-file controls pass.

datasets.finding: Both layers preserve the complete GDAL/OpenFileGDB-decoded source; no analogous omission found.
datasets.resolution: Documented shared decoder and sampled secondary-reader limitations.
datasets.retained_data_affected: No omission found; FileGDB ring encoding and independent scientific truth are outside the existing check.

datasets.finding: Validator did not fully check row-group ranges and scalar statistics against values.
datasets.resolution: Require contiguous source_row min/max, bounded groups, null counts and scalar extrema matching each batch.
datasets.retained_data_affected: Additional full Parquet scan passed on all 8,477,883 retained r2 rows.

datasets.finding: Exact values/scale were checked but declared decimal precision and configured tile zooms were not asserted.
datasets.resolution: Require descriptor-derived decimal128 type and frozen PMTiles zooms.
datasets.retained_data_affected: All 53 fields and zooms0–8 pass the added checks on checksum-bound retained assets.
